] Yet they kept rolling, relishing the wilderness
vistas, invigorating dips in alpine streams, and days of
Montana, where they paused for the winter.
The next year, the group progressed all the way
to Salina Cruz, Mexico; there, the Burdens, hobbled by
minor illnesses, skipped out on the whole thing. The Siples
pressed on, though, traversing the mountainous spine of
South America in 1974 with an ever-changing crew of
tagalong cyclists. When the Siples reached the route’s
end at the tip of Argentina in early 1975, they had each
Hemistour’s messages traveled even farther. The
daring feat having attracted media attention along the
way, circulating the riders’ anyone-can-do-it idea far
and wide. Thus, two-wheeled, idealistic Hemistour
introduced millions of people to the concept of bicycle
